# ADR-3078: A07: Long-lived bearer token for SPA session 6

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Long-lived tokens magnify XSS impact.

## Decision

SPAs SHALL NOT store a long-lived bearer token for SPA session 6 (A07-6) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Prefer short-lived access tokens plus refresh rotation.
